wages.text: He said he would seek a federal minimum-wage increase and supports workers’ right to organize.
wages.quote: I would immediately seek to raise the minimum wage at the federal level, which hasn't been raised since 2009.

tax.text: His campaign says he supports making tax cuts permanent and eliminating taxes on tips and overtime.
tax.quote: That’s why he has voted to support making tax cuts permanent, no tax on tips, and no tax on overtime.

safety.text: His campaign says he will seek increased funding and support for law enforcement.
safety.quote: Max will fight for increased funding and support for law enforcement.

immigration.text: His campaign says he will continue to fight to maintain a secure southern border.
immigration.quote: Max will continue to fight to maintain the secure border.

guns.text: He voted for a resolution disapproving an ATF rule on firearms with stabilizing braces.
guns.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives

abortion.text: He voted for the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act.
abortion.quote:
Vote Question: On Passage

Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act

Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He voted for a bill that would base Title IX athletics sex determinations on reproductive biology and genetics at birth.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

energy.text: His campaign says he supports energy policies intended to develop U.S. energy independence and reduce gas and electricity costs.
energy.quote: Max will continue to support the policies of the Trump administration to develop American energy independence and reduce the costs of gas and electricity.
